evidence: The ALD system was evacuated (ca. 1.5 × 10−1 Torr), and the temperature of the ALD chamber was well stabilized before starting the deposition. All of the samples were in situ cleaned using UV−ozone to remove any organic impurities (500 ms O3 pulse and 30 s exposure, 10 cycles). The temperature of the reaction chamber and the manifolds was maintained at 200 and 115 °C, respectively. Bis(cyclopentadienyl)-nickel (Nickelocene, Ni(Cp)2) and ozone (O3) were used as the metal and oxygen precursors, respectively. The Ni(Cp)2 (contained at 90 °C in a stainless steel bottle) and O3 (at RT) were introduced in a sequential manner using argon both as a carrier and as a purging gas.
